WITH earliest_posts AS (
  SELECT
    t.currency,
    t.amount,
    t.external_ref,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.external_ref ORDER BY t.loaded_at ASC) AS rn
  FROM transactions t
  WHERE t.external_ref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ep.currency,
  COUNT(*) AS postings,
  SUM(ep.amount) AS total_amount
FROM earliest_posts ep
WHERE ep.rn = 1
GROUP BY ep.currency
ORDER BY ep.currency;

SELECT
    (posted_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')::date AS toronto_date,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM
    transactions
WHERE
    currency = 'CAD'
GROUP BY
    (posted_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')::date
ORDER BY
    toronto_date;

SELECT
    c.code AS currency,
    COALESCE(b.bad_rows, 0) AS bad_rows
FROM
    currencies c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        t.currency,
        COUNT(*) AS bad_rows
    FROM
        transactions t
    JOIN
        currencies c2 ON t.currency = c2.code
    WHERE
        numeric_scale(t.amount) > c2.minor_units
    GROUP BY
        t.currency
) b ON c.code = b.currency
ORDER BY
    c.code;

SELECT t_rev.txn_id
FROM transactions AS t_rev
LEFT JOIN transactions AS t_orig
       ON t_rev.reversal_of = t_orig.txn_id
WHERE t_rev.reversal_of IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        t_orig.txn_id IS NULL
     OR t_rev.account_id <> t_orig.account_id
     OR t_rev.currency <> t_orig.currency
     OR t_rev.amount <> -t_orig.amount
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.txn_id) AS reversed_count
FROM transactions t1
JOIN transactions t2 ON t2.reversal_of = t1.txn_id
WHERE t2.account_id = t1.account_id
  AND t2.currency = t1.currency
  AND t2.amount = -t1.amount;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_reversed
FROM transactions t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions r
    WHERE r.reversal_of = t.txn_id
);

SELECT
    r.report_date,
    COUNT(t.txn_id) AS late_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS late_amount
FROM
    report_runs r
JOIN
    transactions t ON t.value_date = r.report_date
WHERE
    t.loaded_at > r.generated_at
GROUP BY
    r.report_date;

WITH stale_reports AS (
  SELECT report_date, generated_at
  FROM report_runs r
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions t
    WHERE t.value_date = r.report_date
      AND t.loaded_at > r.generated_at
  )
)
SELECT
  sr.report_date,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.currency = 'CAD' AND t.loaded_at <= sr.generated_at THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reported_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.currency = 'CAD' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS corrected_total
FROM stale_reports sr
LEFT JOIN transactions t
       ON t.value_date = sr.report_date
      AND t.currency = 'CAD'
GROUP BY sr.report_date
ORDER BY sr.report_date;

WITH earliest_loads AS (
  SELECT external_ref, MIN(loaded_at) AS loaded_at
  FROM transactions
  WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY external_ref
)
SELECT
  (t.posted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')::DATE AS toronto_date,
  SUM(t.amount) AS net_amount
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN earliest_loads e
  ON t.external_ref = e.external_ref
 AND t.loaded_at = e.loaded_at
WHERE (e.external_ref IS NOT NULL OR t.external_ref IS NULL)
  AND t.currency = 'CAD'
GROUP BY toronto_date
ORDER BY toronto_date;
